g.text: Application-subscription configuration | East US 2 | Public access is an explicit demo exception.
Outside the ARM resource group: Entra tenant + limiter API / SPA registrations; app roles and delegated scopes are separate from Azure RBAC.
Pre-created resource group: rg-apim-ai-demo-eus2 | Azure Commercial
Not on the budget decision path
Event Grid system topic: Storage source.
Global anomaly rule; neither authorizes calls.
Both Functions use BOTH Redis and Table Storage. SDK telemetry: both Function hosts and allowlisted browser events.
Supported resource diagnostics also reach Log Analytics. Identity assignments describe credentials, not network routes.
BLUE: HTTPS application calls GREEN: shared state access PURPLE dashed: portal / secret path GRAY dotted: observation
Resource names are abbreviated only where marked ...; resource inventory and identity/audience contracts are in docs/azure-topology.md.
Browser uses own-cloud Graph User.Read for its own name/photo. No Government deployment, private networking, Claude backend or production SLA is implied.
